name: Lock
author: VanillaGreen
description: The lock screen: locks the session with SUPER+L, IPC, the launcher, after idle and before sleep, and unlocks with your password. The session stays locked if the shell stops.

idleLockSeconds.label: Lock after idle
idleLockSeconds.description: Time without input before the session locks

lockBeforeSleep.label: Lock before sleep
lockBeforeSleep.description: Hold each suspend until the session is locked

lock.label: Lock
lock.hint: Hyprland refuses a lock while another lock screen, such as hyprlock, holds the session

sleep.label: Before sleep
sleep.hint: logind holds each suspend until the lock is confirmed, for at most its delay

lastSleep.label: Last suspend
lastSleep.hint: Whether the session was locked before the machine last slept

requirements.purpose: Holds each suspend until the session is locked
Reads how long logind waits for the lock before a suspend
Finds the theme's background image for the lock screen
